Glossary

Every StatusKind, PassiveTrigger, and EffectKind defined in Assets/Scripts/Core/Data/Enums.cs, alphabetized within each category. Definitions synthesized from the enum, its inline comments, and usage across CombatSimulation.cs and the design docs.

StatusKind

  • AttackDown — reduces the holder's effective Attack for its duration. Harmful; contestable by Effect Resist.
  • AttackUp — increases the holder's effective Attack for its duration. Beneficial.
  • Burn — damage-over-time, ticked each round on the holder's own turn. Ember sources stack multiple Burn instances instead of overwriting (see Aspects). Harmful; contestable.
  • DefenseDown — reduces the holder's effective Defence for its duration. Harmful; contestable.
  • DefenseUp — increases the holder's effective Defence for its duration. Beneficial.
  • Focus — increased critical chance for its duration. Beneficial.
  • None — placeholder / "no status" value.
  • Regen — heal-over-time; the mechanic Verdant's overflow-banking rule feeds into instead of discarding wasted healing. Beneficial.
  • Shield — absorbs incoming damage before it reaches HP. Beneficial. Central to Lumen's interception identity via DealRawDamage's absorb block.
  • Silence — blocks the holder's Active on their next turn; a Basic Attack resolves instead. Harmful; contestable.
  • Slow — reduces the holder's effective Speed. Gale's version pushes a target later within the same round it's applied, not just the next one. Harmful; contestable.
  • Stealth — inert placeholder in the current codebase; no targeting-visibility logic is wired to it yet.
  • Stun — skips the holder's entire next turn (no Basic Attack, no Active). Harmful; contestable.
  • Taunt — forces enemy single-target abilities to resolve onto the holder. Applied to Self in every current use (Orrin, and the enemy Stone Warden). Central to Lumen's targeting-override identity via FindTargetAnchor/FindTaunter.

Only harmful statuses (AttackDown, DefenseDown, Burn, Slow, and by category also Silence and Stun) are rolled against EffectResist; beneficial statuses always apply as authored. See Combat Systems.

PassiveTrigger

  • AfterBasicAttack — fires after the holder's Basic Attack resolves. Used by Nyx's Hollowing.
  • BattleStart — fires once, at the start of the battle. Used by Wren's Rootbound.
  • None — placeholder / no trigger.
  • OnBlock — fires when the holder blocks a hit. Defined in the enum but currently unused by any content — the proposed (and rejected-as-specified) Block stat would have needed this to earn its place. See Combat Systems.
  • OnCriticalHit — fires when the holder lands a critical hit. Was used by Ryn's old Follow-Through (now moved to OnKill — see Heroes); currently defined but unused by shipped content.
  • OnDamaged — fires when the holder takes damage. Defined but not used by any current hero or enemy passive.
  • OnHpBelowThreshold — fires once the holder's HP drops below an authored threshold. Used by Orrin's Emberskin.
  • OnKill — fires when the holder's hit kills its target. Used by Ryn's Follow-Through. Central to Gale's turn-re-entry identity, which is keyed on killer.Aspect == Aspect.Gale at the same call site rather than being a passive itself.
  • TurnStart — fires at the start of the holder's own turn. Used by Maeve's Rising Chorus.

EffectKind

  • ApplyStatus — applies a StatusKind to a target, gated by a chance roll (now modified by Effect Hit/Effect Resist for harmful statuses — see Combat Systems).
  • Cleanse — removes one or more harmful statuses from a target. Filters on StatusInfo.IsHarmful and cannot remove an uncleansable Umbra-applied status.
  • Damage — deals damage through the full pipeline described in Combat Systems.
  • Dispel — removes beneficial statuses from a target (the counterpart to Cleanse).
  • EnergyGain — grants energy toward a unit's Active cost. Subject to Tide's overflow-redirect rule when granted by a living Tide source.
  • Heal — restores HP. Subject to Verdant's overflow-banking rule (converts wasted healing to Regen) via ApplyHealValue.
  • Shield — grants an absorb-shield value, added unconditionally to the target's existing Shield (no cap or discard exists on this path — see Open Questions for why two relics were cut after being designed around a discard here that didn't actually exist).
  • SwapPositions — swaps two units' battle-line positions.
